story.title: Rohan and Anonymous Hacker
paragraphs_en: Once there was a boy named Rohan . He was just 9 and his birthday just passed and he got a laptop for his birthday and was just very excited to use it. So, today when he came back from school his mother asked "where are you going rohan" asked his mother. He answered "mamma I am going to my room to try my new laptop" he said , his mother answered "Don't forget to come for lunch. He opened his laptop opened Google and typed some unusual website "www.soeasygames.com" , he opened it and started "playing the tanks of war which he thought was a easy game but was not for him that's what he thought", he kept trying but failed every single time then he went in the players list and found a username which was"iamthebest12345".

He noticed that that username was on the top of the game leaderboard. He opened the chat and privately started chatting with him at first he typed " hello friend how do you win in this game? ". The player answered saying " It's really easy just click on the link I just send you and then click on it, it will lead you to a website and there fill your school, and your phone number". He not knowing the consequences quickly went to his mother asked the following details, his mother not knowing why he was asking that told him. He quickly went to his room and filled the details and thought that he would get the cheats for the game instead he received a text "saying that the cheats will be received by you after 5 days". He patiently waited for the cheats to come

but they never arrived instead his mother and father received texts from their bank that read " A transaction has been done for the following amount of 9,57,370 rupees only". When he woke up in the morning and saw police officers and bank officials inside his house. He panicked and fainted immediately and was taken to the hospital where the doctors said that he fainted due to panicking. That's when his mother remembered that he had come to ask some weird details and now Rohan had no other option except to tell his parents and when he did their parents quickly called a computer professional and quickly found the hacker's location and caught him quickly and for god's sake, all the money was safe.pls hit the the heart and pls read it fully

Cybersecurity means protecting data, networks, programs, and other information from unauthorized or unattended access, destruction, or change. You should never give out your personal details like bank details, phone number and your address to someone else , these thing are supposed to be only know by your family members not the people you don't know
